correctness.rationale: In kinematic normalization dg=dphi dh for unoriented lines, endpoint parameters on two incident sides have Jacobian tu sin^2(theta)/sigma^3. Multiplication by sigma^4 gives a homogeneous degree-three integrand tu sigma, whose Euler divergence has factor five. This reduces the vertex contribution to two one-dimensional primitives. Completing the square and the cosine law give the H_r(p,q) expressions; the positive half-perimeter quotient yields log(s/(s-q)). Summing three vertices and pq sin(theta)=2 area proves the scale-five symmetric formula for every strict triangle side triple. Independent direct normal-angle/offset quadratures for four disparate shapes matched, including the equilateral constant; they are checks, not the proof.
